race.comment: THE HARD ROAD (2) was long odds at Nowra but didn't finish far away before heading to provincial level most recently where he held his own. Now right back in grade and his recent efforts are a nice platform for him to explode third-up. He makes the most appeal. AQUILINO (6) was close up at Canberra, though that was over the mile. Back in trip now, but returns to his home deck and he'll be right in this if he can hold his recent form. RAPID REIGNS (4) was fair without being good on his debut. The stable are trying some things pre-race. Will like added ground. GROUNDCOVER (3) gets the blinkers to find more.
